accounted_for_by_the_vision_exclusion.why: the reduction record's vision_excluded: reduced_vision_n_layers 0 against the release's 32, the workload being text only. bias_vl is here because the adapter gates it on the tower

unaccounted_for.why: a STORAGE-versus-RUNTIME difference, both sides read directly. The released checkpoint's own shard header stores wo_a.weight as F8_E4M3 with an F8_E8M0 scale; the released inference source at the same revision declares ColumnParallelLinear(..., dtype=torch.bfloat16) for it, which registers no scale, because wo_a is consumed inside a torch.einsum that cannot take an fp8 weight and a separate scale -- the release's own comment beside it says convert.py dequantizes wo_a to bf16 and that an fp8 grouped GEMM would halve the memory. The reduced fixture is built from named_parameters() and so follows the source; the adapter models the storage

verdict: the reduced checkpoint is written in the release's RUNTIME shape and this adapter models its STORAGE shape; to be pinned here it must store attn.wo_a as fp8 with a scale, as the released checkpoint's own shard headers do
